scope: Source ownership/cache review with existing focused regression evidence; full final song suite remains live and final core/downstream/app/performance gates remain pending.

noteskin.identity: source_hash includes schema and compiler version; process-local hash cache derives from this identity.
noteskin.regression: backend_cutover_invalidates_the_legacy_cache_without_deleting_it in tests/rust_engine.rs verifies new hash/build, old file unchanged, subsequent reuse. Final noteskin run pending.

song.ownership: CompiledSongLuaData and PreparedGameplaySongLua are in-memory owned Rust payloads. GameplayPreload transfers them through a typed mpsc receiver; no serialized VM/registry handle is reused.
song.persistent_program_cache: No ProgramCache integration or CompiledSongLua serialization implementation occurs in the normal consumer source trees searched. ProgramCache is a separate generic engine facility with source/build identity; final cache_persistence regression is planned.

gifs.ownership: Process LazyLock builds immutable native catalog on startup. Each script/aspect/player capture creates a fresh memory-bounded Rust VM, releases its temporary roots, and emits native data; no persisted VM artifact crosses the backend transition.

session.owner: SongLiveRuntime owns Arc<Mutex<RustSongRuntime>>; application preload worker transfers the owned payload through sync_channel before gameplay access.
session.reentry: access guard is released before applying gameplay writes; nested host calls use HostCall within the already active VM rather than reacquiring the mutex.
session.release: Retained::Drop queues Root values without acquiring VM lock or running Lua. access drains the queue and unpins in that same VM. Final owner destruction releases the VM.

coverage: rust_scene_retirement: 11 controls for retained actors/parent wrappers, weak collection, repeated retirement, message unsubscription, failed End, shared owners, sound ownership, foreign scene rejection
rust_preparation: 21 controls including saved loader callbacks, GC ownership, scope restoration and fatal limits
rust_baked_program and rust_baked_program_tables: native compiled callbacks survive VM destruction without merging mutable cells
rust_actor_copy: retained actor functions and copied values survive collection without sharing source state

session.remaining: Final full song run, relevant core embedding/GC/limits tests, final normal app worker/rendered smoke. No source audit alone substitutes for those runtime gates.
